# hostinger_vps_post_install_script (Resource)

Manages a VPS post-install script.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostinger_vps_post_install_script" "example" {
  name = "Install monitoring agent"

  content = <<-EOT
    #!/bin/bash
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y curl
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Post-install script content.
- `name` (String) Post-install script name.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the post-install script was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (Number) Post-install script ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the post-install script was updated (RFC3339).

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = hostinger_vps_post_install_script.example
  identity = {
    id = 12345
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number)

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = hostinger_vps_post_install_script.example
  id = "12345"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

